plan: Given my value of $25, I should bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while remaining competitive. A rational bidder would bid slightly less than their value to ensure a profit if they win. Since values are between $0 and $20, bidding $20 is optimal. This ensures winning when others bid near their maximum possible value.

Since the values are redrawn independently each round and this is the only round, I should bid just below my private value to maximize profit. Rational bidders will bid close to their values. To ensure winning, I should bid slightly below $20, the maximum possible value, to outbid others while maximizing profit.

Given my value of $23, my goal is to bid just below my value to maximize profit while outbidding others. Rational bidders will also bid close to their values. I should bid slightly below my value, say $22.9, to ensure I win if others bid near their values. This maximizes profit if I win, as the second-highest bid will likely be close to my bid.
